flow.title: Workflow
flow.claim_start: kander start, a new executing agent
flow.delivery_fail: exit 1 fail: whitespace or conflict markers
flow.delivery_incomplete: exit 2 or 3: check did not finish
flow.whitelist_hit: hit, or the user asked for review
flow.sec_cross_primary: the same fix, re-reviewed by enabled PMQA
flow.sec_decision_stop: 3 stop integration, keep branch and worktree
flow.sec_timeout: medium with no decision for 15 min: timed out and ignored
flow.group_patch_equal: rebased patch equals the closed patch
flow.delivery_record_disposition: record every candidate with a disposition
flow.group_notify_sync: notify --kind sync, the author rebases and re-delivers
flow.whitelist_notice_scope: notify the user of the change scope, do not wait
flow.reviewer_opt_skip: 3 skip review, before the plan froze the role
flow.backend_stop_integration: stop integration, keep branch and worktree, wait
flow.backend_security_partial: stage-two decision continues; a required role still needs a run
flow.mf_nonblocking_disposition: still record a disposition for every item
flow.mf_stage_holds: send it to the user, the stage is not released
flow.mf_attribution_decide: the user decides whether it is in scope
flow.mf_advance_no_rerun: review advance, the role passes without a re-run
flow.mf_contract_ask: ask the user when the fix changes the contract
flow.mf_fix_commit: fix and commit on the same base
flow.mf_dispatch_back: notify --kind fix, the author fixes in working/
flow.cap_opt_accept: 1 accept the current state, record as unresolved
flow.cross_security_scope: the security role re-reviews the fix scope
flow.sec_cross_scope: unconditional, limited to the fix scope
flow.sec_accept_record: record the accepted risk and the rationale
flow.sec_other_tiers: other tiers go straight to the unresolved list
flow.sec_timeout_blocking_waits: blocking and high always wait for the user
flow.rebase_reverify: re-verify at the final delivery commit
flow.group_merge_commit: abort the rebase, integrate through a merge commit
flow.group_merge_options: sealed plan: 1 integrate as resolved, 2 stop integration
flow.note_self_review: SELF_REVIEW against the five points before todo/
flow.note_card_review: CARD_REVIEW by an agent outside this session
flow.note_overlap: kander check overlap at every natural pause
flow.note_group_branch: an in-group task branch is created from the group branch
flow.note_smallest_change: the smallest verifiable change; evidence for conclusions
flow.note_commit_by_concern: commit each concern separately, push after each commit
flow.note_self_check_items: 7 items; 1, 2 and 6 come from commands, not from reading
flow.note_delivery_check_minimal: code module off: run at least kander check delivery
flow.note_group_delivery: move review/, the orchestrator verifies and fast-forwards
flow.note_whitelist_entries: 9 entries, judged by the actual changes
flow.note_plan_requirements: review plan freezes base, members and role requirements
flow.note_batch_unit: task groups are reviewed in batches on the group branch
flow.note_stage_na_override: unless a higher-precedence source requires the role
flow.note_stage_invalid: policy unreadable: fix the configuration before relying on this chart
flow.note_batch_close: aggregate, then close with PASSED_AT as a full SHA
flow.note_unresolved_items: rejected, unverifiable, unfixed low tiers, accepted risks, timeouts, roles not completed
flow.note_integration_auth: authorization to execute the card covers merge-back and cleanup
flow.note_integration_verify: push the full commit, ff sync, then verify the ancestor
flow.note_cleanup: only then delete the task branch and worktree
flow.note_finish_own: Git module off: keep your own branch and delivery flow
flow.note_base_from_start: the review base comes from the record at task start
flow.note_wrap_up: notify --kind wrap-up, the author confirms develop and cleans up
flow.note_report_md: write a non-empty report.md through update
flow.note_evidence_gate: the review evidence gate: every batch closed, or an explicit N/A plan
flow.note_move_done: kander move done --result completed, then kander check
flow.note_report_fields: 8 fields in order, N/A where empty
flow.cap_reason: the same finding twice, or three rounds in a batch
flow.note_mode_required: required: runs once review is triggered, unless a higher-precedence source skips it
flow.note_mode_auto: auto: runs per the review profile table and the security trigger conditions
